{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Regalle''''' was a [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] in service to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. ''Regalle'' was part of a task force along with three [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Polow]] with orders to patrol the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

When the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] tried to land on the planet, Polow gave the order to launch their [[XJ5 X-wing starfighter]] squadron and give chase.<ref name="apocalypse" />
